template.title: The Sparkly Cake Surprise
template.summary: A child learns that a small mistake can turn a favorite creation into something even more special.

sentences.text_with_blanks: [[slot_child]] set out to bake a shiny [[slot_creation]] for [[slot_recipient]]'s birthday.
He/she mixed flour, sugar, and milk, dreaming of bright frosting.
Suddenly, a spoon slipped and a splash of [[slot_weird_item]] fell into the batter.
The batter turned a strange color, and [[slot_child]] felt a little worried.
Instead of stopping, [[slot_child]] decided to keep baking, hoping the surprise would be fun.
When the timer rang, [[slot_child]] opened the oven door.
A cloud of colorful steam and glitter puffed out, revealing a lumpy but magnificent [[slot_creation]].
The [[slot_creation]] smelled sweet and a little tangy, and it looked like a rainbow blob.
[[slot_child]] laughed and gave the [[slot_creation]] to [[slot_recipient]], who cheered with delight.
They all learned that a little mistake can make a gift extra special.
